cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a far-future orbital hotel recreation pool under a transparent observation dome — trying the low-gravity relaxation deck after a swim; a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing with one foot up on a step; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — reads a bound bundle of bamboo slips; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; a maintenance shed with a long workbench — types on an open laptop open on the table
